title: Refuse sales targets for unknown reps or without a month
notes: Control: the change is in the service layer (SalesTargetService.setTarget), not in DataStore. Today an unknown rep hits the sales_target foreign key (IllegalStateException 'Cannot save sales target') and a null month throws a NullPointerException. Reference change (+6, service/SalesTargetService.java only): after the positive-target check, refuse a null month and a rep that DataStore.findSalesRepById does not find with IllegalArgumentException('Unknown sales rep: <id>'). Acceptance test (3 cases, via SalesTargetService): unknown rep refused with IllegalArgumentException naming the id and nothing saved; null month refused with IllegalArgumentException; valid target still saved. Verification on a fresh copy of variants/a: test compiles and FAILS (3 run, 2 assertion failures 'Unexpected exception type thrown', 0 errors); with the reference patch it PASSES; mvn -q -o test green (610 tests, 0 failures). ambiguity_measure.py terms (methods hit / files / similar / clustered): sales target 9/3/0.05/0.00, sales rep 76/30/0.06/0.25, month 20/9/0.04/0.00; median 20.
